why: Alan, 3 Oct: "please check for me if they are truly given the full treatment … analysts, financials, stats, everything … I need everything checked for inconsistencies everywhere." Every surface a Hub name appears on, the check that proves it is filled, and the job that fills it when it is not.

run.every_served_name: node scripts/admission-checklist.mjs --all --hub "<Hub checkout>" --bars <U4b R2 walk bars-*.json> --heads <heads-*.json> --comps live --out matrix.json
run.keys: none — the script reads the chart API and the Hub's public browser REST endpoint (the key the Hub page itself carries, read from <Hub>/index.html at run time and never printed). GET only.
run.exit_code: 0 when every applicable surface is OK; 1 when any surface is EMPTY, PLACEHOLDER or ERROR; 2 when the run itself failed

statuses.OK: the surface shows real, current data for this name (or, for a fund, the page's honest 'not an operating company' line, which is the right answer)
statuses.EMPTY: the surface draws but has nothing for this name (a dash, an empty table, 'No recent headlines')
statuses.PLACEHOLDER: the surface shows developer text or a stub instead of data (e.g. READ: 'Desk narrative auto-generates per ticker from read_blocks / ticker_context (DB) once its dossier is loaded.'; ALERTS: parked room)
statuses.ERROR: the surface shows something wrong or stale: an old width, a stale reading, a name the room cannot see

fillable: every non-OK cell also says whether a job can fill it today (fillable: true, with the job) or whether it is a rule/nature (fillable: false, with the reason)
last_session_rule: the last completed US session is the 1d required_through_et the chart API's /geiger reports; a reading older than that is stale

kinds.company: an operating company (tickers.type stock / company_profile.is_etf not true)
kinds.fund: an ETF or fund (tickers.type etf, or company_profile.is_etf true): the FINANCIALS tab becomes HOLDINGS; ESTIMATES, COMPS, EARNINGS show the honest 'not an operating company' line — but ONLY when company_profile.is_etf is true; without a profile row the page treats a fund as a company and draws empty tables

surfaces.label: the name has a row on its cohort board
surfaces.source: public.cohorts (ticker, cohort) — fetchBoardRows() filters every cohort tab by it; chart API /universe adds the declared set to ALL
surfaces.check: a cohorts row exists and the name is in /universe

surfaces.label: LAST
surfaces.check: state OK and price > 0

surfaces.label: CHG % and the previous close
surfaces.check: previous_close_state SETTLED, previous_close > 0, previous session = the last completed session
surfaces.fill: Geiger publisher settled close (automatic once in /universe)

surfaces.label: F P/E
surfaces.source: public.analyst_estimates (4 future quarters within 15 months = NTM, else the next annual) ÷ LAST; withheld for a non-USD reporter (public.filer_currency)
surfaces.check: a forward EPS exists, is > 0, and the reporter is USD

surfaces.label: REVENUE
surfaces.source: public.fundamentals.revenue_ttm (a non-USD reporter shows its currency, not dollars)
surfaces.check: revenue_ttm > 0

surfaces.label: RSI
surfaces.source: public.provider_indicators_current (FMP, 1day, rsi 14, universe_hash in the page's SC_FMP_REFERENCE_DIGESTS)
surfaces.check: row exists for an accepted digest, source_date = the last completed session

surfaces.label: GEIGER
surfaces.check: a composite on 7 of 7 rungs

surfaces.label: RVOL
surfaces.check: a row written on or after the last completed session
surfaces.fill: the minute-bar writer (follows the canonical universe)

surfaces.label: MKT (trading-state dot)
surfaces.check: always drawn

surfaces.label: the chart on all 24 widths (1m … 12M)
surfaces.source: R2 provider bars per width (chart API /candles provider_refresh.requested_through_et; for all names: the U4b R2 walk)
surfaces.check: every width present and refreshed through the last completed session
surfaces.fill: provider-bars-worker (hourly pass covers 17 widths; 2m 45m 8h 2D 3M 6M 12M have no scheduled pass — F1 adds one)

surfaces.label: Geiger 7 rungs
surfaces.check: 7 rungs

surfaces.label: previous close
surfaces.check: SETTLED and PROVIDER_CONFIRMED

surfaces.label: GEIGER tab
surfaces.check: 7 rungs AND the tab's FMP daily readings (Williams %R, moving-average ladder; same export as RSI) current — else the tab prints UNAVAILABLE

surfaces.label: FUNDAMENTALS tab (Station fundamentals shell)
surfaces.check: at least one FY and one quarter of statements

surfaces.label: ESTIMATES tab (analysts)
surfaces.check: future estimates (a missing price target is noted, not failed)

surfaces.label: COMPS tab
surfaces.source: deliverables/20261001/comps-mechanic (C4, live) over company_profile, ticker_industry, fmp_peers, peer_sources
surfaces.check: the live rule keeps ≥ 1 peer (else the tab prints "the comparable set could not be built" — ERROR)
surfaces.fill: fmp-peers-sync / peer-sources-sync (Hub scripts) and a company_profile row with industry and market cap

surfaces.label: FINANCIALS tab (HOLDINGS for a fund)
surfaces.source: company: fundamentals_history FY + Q, balance_history FY, cashflow_history FY · fund: etf_info + etf_holdings (needs company_profile.is_etf true to switch)
surfaces.check: company: FY income, balance and cash flow present · fund: etf_info row and holdings
surfaces.fill: fmp-fundamentals · fund: fmp-backfill?job=etf (and a profile row)

surfaces.label: FINANCIALS → CAPITAL
surfaces.source: public.cashflow_history quarters (capex, last 4) + offering_filings + ipo_lockups + offering_news
surfaces.check: quarterly cash flow with capex present (no offering filing is a true 'none')

surfaces.label: STATS tab
surfaces.check: a profile row with name, and market cap or shares

surfaces.label: NEWS tab
surfaces.check: ≥ 1 headline in the last 30 days

surfaces.label: SOCIAL tab
surfaces.source: X collector feed (keyword match, live) + public.youtube_videos + social_sentiment
surfaces.check: the X feed is current (newest post within 36 h; else the tab prints STALE) and the name has an X or YouTube mention in 30 days ($TICKER, as the page matches)
surfaces.fill: sentiment-youtube / youtube-feed — no fill can create mentions that do not exist

surfaces.label: EARNINGS tab (company)
surfaces.check: a reported quarter (eps_actual) AND the next date

surfaces.label: READ → BUSINESS
surfaces.check: words present (else the developer line 'Desk narrative auto-generates …')

surfaces.label: READ → VERDICT
surfaces.source: read_blocks.verdict → ticker_context.narrative, + the live Geiger sentence
surfaces.check: words present (with no read_blocks row and no dossier the whole READ is the developer line)
surfaces.fill: read-engine (needs any read_blocks row or a dossier)

surfaces.label: READ → CATALYSTS
surfaces.check: words present

surfaces.label: READ → WATCH
surfaces.check: words present

surfaces.label: READ → the dossier and its date
surfaces.check: a row exists; words written within 30 days (the tab prints the age in red past 30)
surfaces.fill: no dossier writer runs (DOSSIER_AGENT_PROTOCOL is a draft; it would call a paid model API)

surfaces.label: EARNINGS room (the calendar)
surfaces.source: public.earnings_events, kept only when the ticker is in public.cohorts (ercRead UNIVERSE)
surfaces.check: in cohorts AND a future earnings date (a date more than 100 days out is flagged for a look)

surfaces.label: NEWS room (the name's cohort tab)
surfaces.source: public.news filtered by news.cohort = the cohort tab (ALL shows everything)
surfaces.check: its last-30-day headlines carry a cohort the name belongs to (public.cohorts)

surfaces.label: ALERTS room
surfaces.source: parkedRoomHTML('ALERTS') — the room is parked for every name
surfaces.fill: a product decision, not a data job
